cards.name: Ajani's Welcome
cards.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Flaxen Intruder // Welcome Home
cards.oracleText:
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice it. When you do, destroy target artifact or enchantment.
Create three 2/2 green Bear creature tokens. (Then exile this card. You may cast the creature later from exile.)

cards.name: Explosive Welcome
cards.oracleText: Explosive Welcome deals 5 damage to any target and 3 damage to any other target. Add {R}{R}{R}.

cards.name: Welcome to . . . // Jurassic Park
cards.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)
I — For each opponent, up to one target noncreature artifact they control becomes a 0/4 Wall artifact creature with defender for as long as you control this Saga.
II — Create a 3/3 green Dinosaur creature token with trample. It gains haste until end of turn.
III — Destroy all Walls. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.
(Transforms from Welcome to ....)
Each Dinosaur card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast cards from your graveyard for their escape cost.)
{T}: Add {G} for each Dinosaur you control.

cards.name: Tocasia's Welcome
cards.oracleText: Whenever one or more creatures you control with mana value 3 or less enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Welcome to Sweettooth
cards.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Create a 1/1 white Human creature token.
II — Create a Food token.
III — Put X +1/+1 counters on target creature you control, where X is one plus the number of Foods you control.
